description: This file contains a class 'UpdateHooks' implementing various Drupal hooks related to the update system, including help, page top modifications, cron tasks, theme and module installation/uninstallation, email notifications, and update archive verification.

classes.name: UpdateHooks
classes.description: A class implementing various Drupal hooks for the update module, handling help display, page modifications, cron tasks, theme/module install/uninstall, email notifications, and update archive verification.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help content for different routes related to the update system.

methods.name: pageTop
methods.description: Adds update notifications or requirements warnings to the page top if user has permission and on specific routes.

methods.name: cron
methods.description: Performs scheduled update checks, data refreshes, and email notifications based on configured intervals.

methods.name: themesInstalled
methods.description: Clears update storage when themes are installed.

methods.name: themesUninstalled
methods.description: Clears update storage when themes are uninstalled.

methods.name: modulesInstalled
methods.description: Clears update storage when modules are installed.

methods.name: modulesUninstalled
methods.description: Clears update storage when modules are uninstalled.

methods.name: mail
methods.description: Constructs email notifications about available updates.

methods.name: verifyUpdateArchive
methods.description: Verifies if an update archive is compatible with Drupal core and modules, preventing unsupported updates.
